_comment: Turn and unfold (Shift+Q) on a block deeper than it is wide: 140 Spearmen, 9 files of 16, facing south, quarter-turn left in place to face east, presenting 16 ranks as their front, 9 deep. The combo's widen then doubles those 16 files across the new facing to 32 files of 5, dealt from where the men stand, as the explicatio drill: each man follows a man he can see (explicatio_following 130 at tick 60, the men still following), the front the turn brought round keeps its line at x 556.0, and the block settles at [537.99, 380.0] when the drill ends by tick 600. On main the widen doubled 16 files against the 9 the block had before the turn, which is no doubling, so the files were dealt anew laterally about the centre: the front fell back from x 556.0 to 525.7 and the block settled at x 507.7. Measured 2026-11-14 on FULL dumps every 60 ticks to tick 720, seed run 0; the drill plays out identically on seed runs 0 to 4 (no enemy, no roll). Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
